description: The packages' handlers of the key commands (arrows, Backspace, Delete, Escape, Space, Tab, MOVE_TO_START, MOVE_TO_END), clicks, pastes and drag and drop: rich and plain text, the list's Backspace, code indentation, TabIndentationExtension and the link's paste of a URL.
